basics.name: Eric Aguayo
basics.headline: Senior AI Engineer | Agentic Systems Architect | AEO Specialist
basics.summary: Senior AI Engineer and Agentic Systems Architect with 15+ years of software engineering excellence, augmented by an MSc in Artificial Intelligence. Specialist in engineering production-grade RAG pipelines, orchestrating Supervisor-Worker agentic workflows, and integrating multi-model LLM systems via LiteLLM. Deep expertise in AEO/GEO — architecting brand authority for Generative Engines through JSON-LD, Schema.org entity graphs, and Knowledge Graph optimization strategies. Proven track record leading high-traffic, enterprise-grade platforms for global brands while driving measurable improvements in AI engine visibility and answer-engine discoverability.

experience.position: Senior AI Engineer & Agentic Systems Consultant
experience.summary:
Architecting AI-native solutions and autonomous agentic systems for clients and startups.

  • Engineered RAG pipelines and Agentic RAG Interfaces for Paftesting/Velir CMS-migration consultancy, improving LLM response accuracy and reducing hallucination rates through ground-truth evaluation frameworks.
  • Conducted LLM Hallucination Audits for client AI integrations, establishing structured evaluation protocols and flagging schema gaps impacting answer-engine trustworthiness.
  • Implemented Schema.org structured data and JSON-LD markup across multiple client properties, optimizing entity authority and brand discoverability for Generative Engines (AEO/GEO).
  • Architected meli.run: Athlete Profile & Blog Platform using React/Next.js, Decap CMS, and GitHub Actions CI/CD with structured data for AI-engine indexability.

Architected scalable interfaces for high-traffic media entities, improving structured data coverage and AI engine crawlability.

  • bleacherreport.com – Orchestrated frontend architecture overhaul for a 50M+ MAU sports media entity, enhancing structured data coverage and content crawlability for AI indexing engines.
  • nypost.com – Engineered AdTech bid-optimization library improvements, increasing ad-event tracking accuracy by 15% and reducing revenue loss from misbid events.
  • la.sonychannel.com – Architected Drupal migration to a modern stack with Schema.org entity markup, boosting content discoverability across search and generative engines.
  • nspower.ca – Integrated LoginRadius identity platform and enterprise SSO for a 500K+ user unified authentication experience.
  • redspace.com – Led site redesign, resolved backend bottlenecks, and elevated CMS editorial performance.

Delivered full-stack Drupal platforms for government, health, and NGO clients with emphasis on structured data and AI-engine-friendly architecture.

  • wsscwater.com – Architected and launched a responsive Drupal platform serving 1M+ users with complex data migration; implemented Schema.org markup improving knowledge-graph entity coverage.
  • lmi.org – Refactored tightly coupled frontend into a decoupled, maintainable architecture, improving page performance and data crawlability for AI engines.
  • hfsa.org – Engineered events content system with JSON-LD structured data, improving event entity discoverability in answer engines.
  • inee.org – Orchestrated multilingual content search via Apache Solr, enabling structured content retrieval across 5 languages.

Architected and led enterprise platforms for US and LATAM clients, pioneering Knowledge Graph and entity optimization strategies alongside agentic editorial workflows.

  • Engineered Agentic RAG Interfaces for content-discovery workflows, integrating AI-assisted editorial pipelines that reduced content production time by 25%.
  • Implemented Schema.org optimization initiatives across 15+ client properties, establishing entity authority frameworks that improved generative engine citation rates.
  • usfq.edu.ec – Orchestrated Digital Marketing web development team; redesigned institutional platform in Drupal with high-availability infrastructure and Schema.org entity graphs for institutional authority.
  • help.blackboard.com – Architected scalable Drupal migration with a semi-autonomous multilingual translation workflow, optimizing structured content for AI-engine indexability across 10+ languages.
